name: Title card — newspaper
description: Full-frame newspaper-style chapter title card. Display headline + mono dateline (JetBrains Mono, bottom of card). The newspaper Surface is an intact printed paper substrate (clean printed edges), not a torn clipping — aesthetic.md § Collage System / Cut behavior is scoped to the channel's torn-collage-card layer, not the underlying substrate. Lean-out (a) brightness-reveal deliberately omitted — focal arrival is carried by halo-bloom-up + settled-place; brightness-reveal is reserved for spoken-content text. Lean-out (b) registration jitter n/a — no saturated marks. Lean-out (c) the title cap-height exceeds G4's Surface-title band (60–110 px) by design — with a dateLabel only, the title takes the Display-headline role the rubric doesn't yet codify (Critic-filed rubric-gap). Halftone + ink-bleed physics are declared on the newspaper Surface via shaderPass per ADR-0008 but render only once the compose-pipeline invocation lands (same deferral as ADR-0005's overlay shader passes). Verifies the newspaper Surface and washi-tape Overlay added by ADR-0008 / ADR-0009.
